title: Compute benchmark quantities for SiN, SiN₂, Si₂N
action: Using an open-source quantum chemistry package, perform geometry optimization and harmonic vibrational frequency calculations for SiN (doublet), SiN₂ (triplet asymmetric linear SiNN), and Si₂N (doublet symmetric linear SiNSi) at the DFT/B3LYP/6-311G(d) level. For SiN, also perform a TDDFT vertical excitation energy calculation at the same level for the A²Π ← X²Σ⁺ transition. Write the optimized bond lengths, harmonic frequencies, and transition energy to the output JSON file.
description: JSON file containing computed equilibrium bond lengths (Å), harmonic vibrational frequencies (cm⁻¹), and vertical excitation energy (cm⁻¹) for the benchmark systems.
output_schema: A JSON object with keys: "SiN" (object with keys "re" (float, Å), "we" (float, cm⁻¹), "T_A2Pi" (float, cm⁻¹)), "SiN2" (object with keys "r_NN" (float, Å), "r_SiN" (float, Å), "we1" (float, cm⁻¹), "we2" (float, cm⁻¹), "we3" (float, cm⁻¹)), "Si2N" (object with keys "r_SiN" (float, Å), "we1" (float, cm⁻¹), "we2" (float, cm⁻¹), "we3" (float, cm⁻¹)).
